products.name: Directional Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of directional drilling and associated support services, including downhole navigational tools, well planning, site supervision, and accommodation rentals, utilizing proprietary measurement-while-drilling and logging-while-drilling technologies. Delivered with physical equipment and skilled personnel at customer wellsites.

products.name: Completion Services
products.description: Comprehensive well completion services including coiled tubing, wireline (pump down perforating, logging, pipe recovery), pressure control, wellhead and hydraulic fracturing rentals, flowback and testing, thru-tubing, fishing, rig assist snubbing, cementing, acidizing, pressure pumping, and provision of downhole completion tools. Delivered with specialized equipment, proprietary tools, and technical personnel at the wellsite.

products.name: Production Services
products.description: Services and equipment to enhance and maintain oil and gas production, including maintenance-related intervention, production blow out preventers, mechanical wireline, hydro-testing, premium tubulars, and proprietary downhole production tools. Delivered with field technicians and specialized equipment throughout the well lifecycle.

products.name: Well Intervention Services
products.description: Engineered solutions for downhole complications, including fishing, thru-tubing, and pipe recovery, using proprietary and patented intervention tools and highly skilled technicians. Delivered on-site with specialized equipment to remediate well issues and restore operations.

products.name: Hydraulic Fracturing Rental Equipment
products.description: Rental of hydraulic fracturing stacks, blow out preventers, valves, tubulars, and related wellhead equipment for use in completion and stimulation operations. Delivered as physical rental assets with installation and support services at customer sites.

products.name: Downhole Tools and Completion Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of proprietary downhole tools and completion products such as dissolvable plugs (e.g., PhantM™), composite plugs, toe sleeves, liner hangers, stage cementing tools, and other specialized equipment. Delivered as physical products for use in drilling, completion, and intervention operations.

products.name: Bryostatin-1 Therapeutics
products.description: Drug candidates based on Bryostatin-1, a natural product and PKC ε activator, developed for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative or cognitive diseases. These are produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered as clinical-stage therapeutics, requiring regulated clinical trials and FDA approval.

products.name: PUFA Analogs Therapeutics
products.description: Drug prototypes termed 'PUFA analogs' synthesized for activation of PKC ε, evaluated as potential follow-on drug candidates for neuroregeneration in Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. These are developed through chemical synthesis and pharmaceutical manufacturing, requiring preclinical and clinical testing.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Treasury and Staking Services (TAO)
products.description: A cryptocurrency treasury strategy focused on acquiring and staking TAO, the native cryptocurrency of Bittensor, for revenue generation and capital appreciation. This involves digital asset management, staking through third-party validators, and participation in decentralized blockchain networks for yield generation.

products.name: The TAO Daily Media Platform
products.description: A media, news, and insight platform dedicated to Bittensor (TAO) and the TAO ecosystem, providing information, resources, and podcasts to users and investors. This is a digital-only service delivered via web and audio content.

products.name: AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK (avutometinib capsules; defactinib tablets)
products.description: An oral combination therapy of avutometinib (a dual RAF/MEK inhibitor) and defactinib (a FAK inhibitor), manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations, and delivered as a co-packaged prescription product for the treatment of KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer (LGSOC). Commercially available in the U.S. through specialty pharmacies and distributors.

products.name: VS-7375 (KRAS G12D Inhibitor)
products.description: A clinical-stage, orally administered small molecule inhibitor targeting KRAS G12D mutations in solid tumors, including pancreatic, non-small cell lung, and colorectal cancers. Manufactured through supply agreements and contract manufacturing organizations, currently in Phase 1/2 clinical trials as both monotherapy and in combination with other agents.

products.name: Connected Operations Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-based platform that consolidates data from IoT devices, connected assets, and third-party systems to provide real-time operational visibility, analytics, and actionable AI-driven insights for physical operations businesses. Delivered as a subscription service, it integrates multiple applications and automates workflows across fleets, equipment, sites, and frontline workers.

products.name: AI Video-Based Safety Solutions
products.description: AI-powered video safety applications using IoT vehicular cameras and computer vision to detect safety risks in real time, provide in-cab alerts, automate coaching, and reconstruct incidents for fleets and sites. Delivered via hardware (dash cams, multicams, wearables) and cloud software, these solutions help reduce accidents and insurance costs.

products.name: Fleet Operations Management
products.description: A suite of applications for managing commercial vehicle fleets, including telematics (real-time GPS tracking, diagnostics), routing, commercial navigation, fuel and EV management, and compliance tools. Delivered through cloud software and IoT hardware, these tools optimize fleet efficiency, safety, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Asset Management and Tracking
products.description: Applications and IoT hardware for tracking, monitoring, and maintaining high-value physical assets (powered and unpowered equipment, tools) with real-time location, diagnostics, and utilization data. Enables theft prevention, asset recovery, and preventative maintenance through cloud-based dashboards and automated workflows.

products.name: Frontline Worker Productivity Solutions
products.description: Digital applications to improve productivity, safety, and compliance for frontline workers, including Connected Forms for digitizing paperwork and inspections, and Connected Training for personalized, data-driven learning modules. Delivered via mobile apps and cloud software, these tools automate manual processes and upskill workers.

products.name: AI Agents for Operations Automation
products.description: AI-powered agents that automate complex, data-heavy operational tasks such as safety risk analysis, real-time coaching, and workflow orchestration. These agents leverage Samsara’s operational dataset to reduce manual labor and improve decision-making across customer operations.

products.name: Site Visibility Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based AI applications that integrate with third-party cameras to provide advanced visibility, hazard detection, and incident management for physical sites such as job sites and warehouses. Enables customers to identify workplace hazards and operational inefficiencies in real time.

products.name: IoT Devices for Data Capture
products.description: A range of self-installed IoT hardware devices (vehicle gateways, asset gateways, asset tags, wearables) designed to capture operational data from vehicles, equipment, and workers, and connect it to the cloud for analysis and workflow automation. Devices are manufactured by third parties and are integral to the platform’s data ingestion.

products.name: Bel-sar (Virus-like Drug Conjugate Oncology Therapeutics)
products.description: A precision oncology therapeutic based on virus-like drug conjugates (VDCs), designed to selectively target and kill tumor cells via light-activated cytotoxic payloads and immune activation. Bel-sar is physically manufactured as a biologic drug and delivered locally (e.g., intraocular or intravesical injection) with light activation, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical administration.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Neurological Diseases
products.description: Intravenously delivered adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies, primarily using proprietary TRACER Capsids, targeting neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Friedreich’s ataxia, Parkinson’s disease, Gaucher disease, Huntington’s disease, spinal muscular atrophy, and other CNS disorders. These therapies are developed through both wholly-owned and partnered programs and require advanced biological manufacturing and regulated clinical development.

products.name: Anti-Tau Antibody Therapeutics for Alzheimer’s Disease
products.description: Intravenously administered, recombinant, humanized monoclonal antibodies (e.g., VY7523) designed to inhibit the spread of pathological tau protein in Alzheimer’s disease. These biologics are produced using advanced antibody engineering and require clinical and regulatory development.

products.name: Non-Viral Neurotherapeutic Delivery Platform (Voyager NeuroShuttle)
products.description: A non-viral delivery platform leveraging proprietary receptor-binding molecules (e.g., ALPL-VYGR-NeuroShuttle) to transport neurotherapeutics, including small molecules and biologics, across the blood-brain barrier for the treatment of neurological diseases. This platform is in early research and proof-of-concept stages and is intended for external partnerships and product development.

products.name: TRACER Capsid Licensing and Collaboration Services
products.description: Licensing of proprietary TRACER AAV capsids and related intellectual property to external partners (e.g., Novartis, Alexion/AstraZeneca) for use in the development and commercialization of gene therapies targeting various CNS and rare neurological diseases. This business line involves technology transfer, research support, and milestone/royalty-based revenue.

products.name: Small Molecule Therapeutics for Neurodegenerative Diseases
products.description: Discovery and development of selective small molecule drugs, in collaboration with partners (e.g., Transition Bio), targeting neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia with TDP-43 pathology. These are developed through external research collaborations and may be licensed for further development and commercialization.

products.name: Snacks
products.description: Manufactured grain, fruit, and savory snacks, nutrition bars, and frozen hot snacks, distributed globally through retail and foodservice channels. Production involves large-scale food processing and packaging.

products.name: Ready-to-Eat Cereal
products.description: Manufactured ready-to-eat breakfast cereals, produced in large-scale facilities and distributed globally under various brands. Delivered through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Convenient Meals
products.description: Prepared meal kits, ethnic meals, pizza, soup, side dish mixes, frozen breakfast, and frozen entrees, produced in manufacturing plants and distributed via retail and foodservice.

products.name: Wholesome Natural Pet Food
products.description: Manufactured natural and wholesome pet food products, primarily for dogs and cats, distributed through pet specialty and mass retail channels. Production involves regulated food processing for animals.

products.name: Refrigerated and Frozen Dough
products.description: Manufactured refrigerated and frozen dough products for baking, distributed to retail and foodservice customers. Production requires temperature-controlled processing and packaging.

products.name: Baking Mixes and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured baking mixes and ingredients, including flour and other baking staples, produced in food processing facilities and distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Yogurt
products.description: Manufactured yogurt products, produced in dairy processing facilities and distributed through retail and foodservice channels under various brands.

products.name: Super-Premium Ice Cream
products.description: Manufactured super-premium ice cream, produced in specialized facilities and distributed globally, including through joint ventures. Delivered via retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Foodservice Products
products.description: A broad portfolio of food products, including many of the above categories, specifically packaged and distributed for commercial and noncommercial foodservice operators and distributors.

products.name: Digital Wholesale Vehicle Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform facilitating the buying and selling of wholesale used vehicles among dealers and commercial sellers, operating 24/7 via online and mobile applications. The marketplace includes features such as real-time bidding, 'buy now' options, and simulcast auctions, and is supported by integrated technology, data analytics, and vehicle logistics centers.

products.name: SaaS-Based Private Label Remarketing Platforms
products.description: Customizable, SaaS-based digital platforms provided to commercial customers (OEMs, finance companies, fleet operators) for private label remarketing of vehicles, including online sales formats and inventory management tools.

products.name: Floorplan Financing
products.description: Short-term, inventory-secured financing solutions (floorplan financing) provided primarily to independent vehicle dealers, enabling them to purchase wholesale inventory. Delivered through a hybrid of physical locations and a digital servicing network.

products.name: Transportation and Vehicle Logistics Services
products.description: Transportation and logistics services for vehicles, utilizing licensed third-party carriers and proprietary technology for automated vehicle shipping, including instant price quotes and delivery scheduling.

products.name: Vehicle Inspection and Condition Reporting Services
products.description: Comprehensive vehicle inspection and condition reporting services, including pre- and post-sale inspections, inventory verification, and compliance auditing, using proprietary technologies and AI-powered tools.

products.name: Vehicle Reconditioning and Mechanical Services
products.description: Reconditioning and mechanical repair services to prepare vehicles for sale, primarily offered at vehicle logistics centers, including cleaning, minor repairs, and maintenance.

products.name: Title, Administrative, and Collateral Recovery Services
products.description: End-to-end management of vehicle titling, repossession administration, inventory management, and collateral recovery, including a proprietary digital platform for repossession management.

products.name: Vehicle Research and Market Data Services
products.description: Provision of real-time vehicle information, pricing guides, history reports, and market analytics to dealers, accessible via mobile app and integrated with third-party data sources.

products.name: CSN Therapeutics (Clean-Surfaced Nanotechnology Therapeutics)
products.description: A pipeline of novel, catalytically-active nanocrystal-based therapeutics, primarily gold nanocrystals (CNM-Au8), developed using a proprietary electro-crystal-chemistry platform. These are physically manufactured as aqueous suspensions or gel polymers and delivered orally or topically for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS, MS, and Parkinson’s disease.

products.name: Antiviral and Antibacterial Therapeutics (CNM-ZnAg and CNM-AgZn17)
products.description: Therapeutic agents comprised of zinc and silver ions, produced via the proprietary electrochemistry platform, formulated as oral solutions (CNM-ZnAg) or topical gels (CNM-AgZn17) for broad-spectrum antiviral, antibacterial, and wound healing applications. These are physically manufactured and delivered as ionic solutions or gels.

products.name: Dietary Supplements (Gold and Zinc-Silver Ion Supplements)
products.description: Very low concentration dietary (mineral) supplements containing gold nanocrystals or zinc-silver ions, manufactured using the proprietary electrochemistry platform. These are marketed and distributed as aqueous solutions for general health and immune support, sold through subsidiaries or licensed partners.

products.name: Commercial LED Lighting and Control Systems
products.description: Energy Focus designs, manufactures, and sells energy-efficient LED lighting fixtures, retrofit kits, tubular LED lamps, and smart lighting controls for commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, and retail facilities. These products are physically manufactured and delivered, often requiring installation and integration with building systems.

products.name: Military Maritime LED Lighting Products
products.description: The company produces robust, military-grade LED lighting fixtures and retrofit lamps specifically designed for naval and maritime applications, including products like Intellitube®, Invisitube™, globe lights, berth lights, and high-bay kits. These are manufactured to meet stringent durability and reliability standards for military use.

products.name: Energy Storage Systems (ESS)
products.description: Energy Focus develops and sells energy storage systems for commercial, industrial, and data center applications, supporting grid stability, renewable energy integration, and backup power. These are physical systems leveraging power electronics expertise and are delivered as installed infrastructure.

products.name: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) Systems
products.description: The company offers advanced UPS systems, including AI-driven solutions, primarily for data centers to ensure uninterrupted power supply and optimized energy management. These are manufactured hardware products incorporating advanced algorithms for reliability and efficiency.

products.name: Gallium Nitride (GaN) Power Supplies
products.description: Energy Focus designs and sells high-efficiency GaN-based power supplies for applications requiring compact, lightweight, and high-performance power conversion, such as consumer electronics, industrial equipment, and renewable energy systems. These are advanced electronic hardware products.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit, credit, and fee-based products to individual and small business customers through a national branch network and digital channels. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, physical branches, and digital platforms.

products.name: Corporate and Institutional Banking Services
products.description: Offers specialized financial services to corporations and government entities, including corporate banking, real estate finance, and asset-based lending. Services are delivered through relationship managers and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Wealth Management and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provides wealth management, investment advisory, and asset management services to individuals, families, and institutions. Delivered via licensed professionals and digital platforms, subject to fiduciary and investment regulations.

products.name: Securities Underwriting and Market-Making
products.description: Engages in securities underwriting and market-making activities for clients, requiring financial capital, regulatory compliance, and specialized personnel. Delivered through broker-dealer subsidiaries and digital trading platforms.

products.name: Merchant Banking and Investment Banking Services
products.description: Provides merchant banking, advisory, and investment banking services, including equity investments and related activities. Delivered through specialized teams and regulated subsidiaries.

products.name: Derivatives and Foreign Exchange Services
products.description: Offers derivatives and foreign exchange products to clients, including swaps and hedging solutions. Requires registration as a swap dealer and compliance with CFTC and OCC regulations.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides treasury management solutions to business clients, including cash management, payment processing, and liquidity solutions. Delivered via digital platforms and relationship managers.

products.name: Nautilus Voyager Platform
products.description: An integrated, single-molecule proteomic analysis platform that includes instrumentation, consumables (flow cells, affinity reagents, library prep kits), and machine learning-based cloud software for comprehensive protein and proteoform quantification. Delivered as a physical instrument with recurring consumables and software subscriptions, designed for laboratory use in research settings.

products.name: Proteomics Analysis Services (Nautilus Proteomics Analysis Services)
products.description: Fee-for-service proteomic analysis using the Nautilus Voyager platform, where customer samples are processed at Nautilus facilities and results are delivered via a cloud-based platform. Enables access to standardized and custom proteomic assays without instrument purchase.

products.name: Broadscale Proteomics Assays (Broadscale Proteome Analysis)
products.description: Standardized assay kits and workflows for large-scale, system-level quantification of canonical proteins across biological states, using proprietary multi-affinity reagents on the Nautilus Voyager platform. Delivered as consumable kits and software workflows for use with the Voyager instrument or as a service.

products.name: Targeted Proteoform Analysis Assays
products.description: Assay kits and workflows for the identification and quantification of specific protein forms, modifications, and variants (proteoforms), including disease-relevant targets such as Tau and alpha-synuclein, using high-specificity affinity reagents on the Nautilus Voyager platform. Delivered as consumable kits and software workflows for use with the Voyager instrument or as a service.

products.name: Machine Learning Proteomics Analysis Software (SaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based software suite that decodes raw data from the Nautilus Voyager platform into protein and proteoform identifications and counts, leveraging proprietary machine learning algorithms. Delivered as a subscription service, enabling ongoing improvements and re-analysis of prior data.

products.name: Agency Lending
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of multifamily and commercial real estate loans through Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and HUD programs. Involves underwriting, risk-sharing, and compliance with agency requirements; requires financial capital, regulatory approvals, and specialized underwriting expertise.

products.name: Debt Brokerage
products.description: Brokerage of commercial real estate debt by matching borrowers with banks and institutional lenders, earning origination fees. Does not require funding loans directly; relies on relationships and advisory expertise.

products.name: Property Sales Brokerage
products.description: Brokerage services for the sale of multifamily, hospitality, and other commercial real estate properties nationwide. Involves in-person transaction professionals and market expertise; generates commissions from property sales.

products.name: Appraisal and Valuation Services
products.description: Provision of multifamily and commercial real estate appraisal and valuation services, leveraging proprietary technology and data science for speed and consistency. Delivered digitally and through in-person appraisers to lenders and investors.

products.name: Loan Servicing and Asset Management
products.description: Servicing and asset management of originated and brokered loans, including payment processing, escrow administration, reporting, and compliance. Requires regulated infrastructure, technology, and human labor; generates recurring servicing fees.

products.name: Investment Management (Commercial Real Estate Funds)
products.description: Management of private commercial real estate investment funds, including senior debt, mezzanine debt, preferred equity, and joint venture equity investments. Involves raising and managing third-party capital, regulatory compliance, and earning management and performance fees.

products.name: Affordable Housing Real Estate Services and LIHTC Syndication
products.description: Syndication of low-income housing tax credits (LIHTC), investment management, and development of affordable housing projects through joint ventures. Involves forming and managing LIHTC funds, earning syndication and asset management fees, and participating in development economics.

products.name: Housing Market Research and Real Estate Investment Banking
products.description: Provision of housing market research data, publications, and real estate investment banking services, including M&A advisory and capital markets solutions. Delivered digitally and through advisory professionals to financial institutions and real estate clients.

products.name: KIO-301 Vision Restoration Therapy
products.description: A novel small molecule 'photoswitch' therapy designed to restore vision in patients with inherited and age-related degenerative retinal diseases, such as retinitis pigmentosa and other rod-dominant retinal dystrophies. Delivered via injection, it is developed through pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical trials, and is intended for commercial distribution upon regulatory approval.

products.name: KIO-104 Retinal Inflammation Therapy
products.description: A third-generation, non-steroidal small-molecule DHODH inhibitor formulated for intravitreal delivery to treat retinal inflammatory diseases, including diabetic macular edema and posterior non-infectious uveitis. Manufactured as an injectable pharmaceutical product, it is developed for commercial sale following regulatory approval.

products.name: KIO-101 Ophthalmic Autoimmune Disease Therapy
products.description: A topical ophthalmic formulation of a DHODH inhibitor for treating ocular manifestations of autoimmune diseases, such as the ocular presentation of rheumatoid arthritis (OPRA+). Produced as an eye drop, it is intended for commercial development and sale through partnerships or direct commercialization upon approval.

products.name: Enterprise Wireless Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions for enterprise customers, including 5G smart repeaters (Lighthouse), embedded cellular modems (NimbeLink), asset tracking devices, and IoT antennas. Products are manufactured externally and delivered as physical devices, often bundled with cloud-based management and subscription services.

products.name: Automotive Wireless Connectivity Solutions
products.description: System-level wireless connectivity products for vehicles, including the AirgainConnect Fleet 5G vehicle gateway and rugged external antennas. These solutions combine hardware, embedded software, and cloud-based management, and are physically manufactured and installed in fleet and aftermarket automotive applications.

products.name: Consumer Embedded Antenna Solutions
products.description: Embedded antennas for consumer wireless devices such as access points, wireless gateways, FWA devices, Wi-Fi routers, and smart home products. These are physical components integrated into OEM/ODM products, optimized for performance and manufacturability, and support multiple wireless standards (Wi-Fi, 4G/5G, Bluetooth, GNSS).

products.name: Cloud-Based Device Management and Analytics Platforms
products.description: Subscription-based cloud platforms (such as AirgainConnect Cloud and NLink) that provide device management, analytics, remote updates, and integration with enterprise systems. Delivered digitally, these platforms generate recurring revenue and are bundled with hardware solutions for ongoing customer engagement.

products.name: RFID Inlays, Tags, and Labels
products.description: Manufactured physical devices embedded with RFID chips and antennas, designed to be attached or integrated into physical objects for tracking, authentication, and connectivity to the IoT. Production involves in-house design, prototyping, and mass manufacturing in certified facilities.

products.name: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Enabled Devices and Labels
products.description: Physical devices and labels incorporating BLE technology, enabling advanced IoT applications such as real-time tracking, authentication, and condition monitoring. These are designed, prototyped, and mass-produced, often for high-value use cases where traditional RFID is insufficient.

products.name: Custom IoT Solutions (RFID/BLE/Sensor Integration)
products.description: Highly customized IoT solutions integrating RFID, BLE, sensors, and various electronic components, tailored to specific customer requirements in sectors like healthcare, logistics, and consumer devices. Delivered through collaborative design, prototyping, and production processes.

products.name: Industrial Packaging Products and Services
products.description: Manufacture and sale of rigid industrial packaging products (steel, fibre, plastic drums, intermediate bulk containers, jerrycans, closure systems, transit protection products, water bottles, remanufactured and reconditioned containers) and related services (container life cycle management, logistics, warehousing, packaging services) delivered globally through physical manufacturing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Paper Packaging Products
products.description: Production and sale of containerboard, corrugated sheets, corrugated containers, and other corrugated products, primarily for North American customers, manufactured using paper mills and converting facilities.

products.name: Recycled Paperboard and Industrial Paper Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of coated and uncoated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores, construction products, protective packaging, and specialty partitions, produced from recycled fiber and paperboard at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Recycled Fiber and Adhesives
products.description: Purchase and resale of recycled fiber and production and sale of adhesives used in paperboard products, involving procurement and processing of recycled materials and chemical manufacturing.

products.name: Timber Sales
products.description: Harvesting and sale of timber from company-owned timberland in the southeastern United States, involving forestry management and sustainable yield practices.

products.name: Land Sales
products.description: Sale of timberland and special use land (surplus, higher and better use, and development land) to third parties, involving real estate transactions of company-owned land assets.

products.name: Adrulipase Therapy
products.description: An orally administered, non-systemic, biologic capsule containing recombinant lipase enzyme produced via recombinant DNA technology in Yarrowia lipolytica yeast, designed for the treatment of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI) in patients with cystic fibrosis and chronic pancreatitis. The product is manufactured by contract organizations and delivered as an oral capsule with enteric microgranule formulation to enable targeted delivery in the digestive tract.

products.name: SynCardia Total Artificial Heart (TAH) System
products.description: A biventricular replacement device that fully replaces the function of a failing human heart, consisting of an implant (available in 50cc and 70cc sizes), external pneumatic drivers (C2 Driver for hospital use and Freedom Driver for home use), and drivelines. Manufactured using proprietary biocompatible materials and assembled in a controlled environment, the system is surgically implanted and provides mechanical circulatory support for patients with end-stage biventricular heart failure.

products.name: External Pneumatic Drivers (C2 Driver and Freedom Driver)
products.description: External pneumatic driver systems that power the SynCardia TAH implant, including the C2 Driver for in-hospital use and the Freedom Driver for portable, in-home use. These devices are manufactured and serviced by PMI, and are essential for the operation of the TAH, providing precisely calibrated pulses of air to drive the artificial ventricles.

products.name: Next Generation Fully Implantable Artificial Heart (Emperor TAH)
products.description: A next-generation, fully implantable artificial heart system under development, designed to eliminate the need for external pneumatic drivers by incorporating an internal driver system. The Emperor TAH builds upon PMI's existing ventricular platform and is undergoing non-clinical testing, with plans for regulatory approval.

products.name: Upgraded and Next Generation Driver Systems (Freedom+ Driver, Unicorn Driver, Companion 3 Driver)
products.description: A pipeline of upgraded and next generation external driver systems for the SynCardia TAH, including the Freedom+ Driver (portable), Unicorn Driver (next generation with improved portability and reliability), and Companion 3 Driver (hospital use). These are designed to improve durability, reduce size and weight, and enhance patient quality of life, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Molecular Glue Degrader (MGD) Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of orally bioavailable small molecule drugs (MGDs) designed to selectively degrade disease-driving proteins via targeted protein degradation, produced through proprietary chemical synthesis and rational design using the QuEENTM discovery engine. Delivered as pharmaceutical products for various indications including immunology, inflammation, cardiology, and oncology.

products.name: VAV1-directed MGDs (including MRT-6160) for Immune-Mediated Diseases
products.description: Orally bioavailable small molecule MGDs targeting VAV1 protein to modulate T- and B-cell activity, developed via proprietary discovery and licensed to Novartis for global development and commercialization. Delivered as pharmaceutical therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

products.name: NEK7-directed MGDs (including MRT-8102) for Inflammatory and Cardiovascular Diseases
products.description: Orally bioavailable MGDs targeting NEK7 to suppress NLRP3 inflammasome activity, produced via proprietary chemical synthesis and AI-enabled discovery, delivered as pharmaceutical products for inflammatory diseases such as ASCVD, gout, hidradenitis suppurativa, and obesity.

products.name: GSPT1-directed MGDs (including MRT-2359) for Oncology
products.description: Orally bioavailable MGDs targeting GSPT1, a translation termination factor, to treat MYC-driven cancers such as metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Developed using proprietary discovery and delivered as pharmaceutical therapies, including in combination with AR inhibitors.

products.name: Cyclin E1-directed MGDs for Solid Tumors
products.description: Small molecule MGDs designed to selectively degrade cyclin E1, an oncogenic driver in multiple solid tumors, produced via proprietary chemical synthesis and delivered as oral pharmaceutical therapies for cancers with CCNE1 amplification or overexpression.

products.name: CDK2-directed MGDs for Cancer
products.description: Orally bioavailable MGDs targeting CDK2, a key cell cycle kinase, to treat cancers with cyclin-dependent kinase pathway alterations, including ER+ breast cancer. Produced via proprietary discovery and delivered as pharmaceutical therapies, potentially in combination with standard of care.

products.name: Drug Discovery and Research Services via QuEENTM Platform (Collaborations with Roche and Novartis)
products.description: Provision of proprietary drug discovery and preclinical research services using the QuEENTM discovery engine to identify and develop MGDs for external partners (e.g., Roche, Novartis), including target identification, lead optimization, and preclinical candidate delivery. Delivered as research collaborations and licensing agreements.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Loans
products.description: Loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including commercial property, business property, multifamily, and construction loans. These loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and require in-person underwriting, collateral evaluation, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Loans
products.description: Commercial term loans and lines of credit provided to businesses for working capital, equipment purchases, business acquisitions, and warehouse lending. These loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and require in-person underwriting, collateralization, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Consumer Loans
products.description: Loans to individuals, including residential mortgage loans (primarily adjustable-rate mortgages) and other consumer loans such as automobile loans, unsecured lines of credit, and term loans to high net worth individuals. These are originated through branches and require underwriting and collateral evaluation.

products.name: SBA Lending
products.description: Small Business Administration (SBA) 7(a) and 504 loans to qualifying businesses for working capital, equipment, business acquisition, and owner-occupied real estate. The bank originates, sells, and services these loans, with a centralized SBA Loan Department and nationwide Preferred Lender status.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Traditional retail deposit accounts including demand, savings, money market, and time deposits, offered through physical branches and digital platforms. These products are a primary funding source and are managed with competitive rates and customer service.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: A suite of commercial treasury management and cash management services, including balance reporting, account transfers, wire transfer initiation, ACH origination, remote deposit capture, positive pay, zero balance accounts, and sweep accounts. Delivered via digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Digital banking solutions for individuals and businesses, including online account access, transfers, bill payment, electronic statements, mobile check deposit, and mobile bill pay. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms.

products.name: ATM and Debit Card Services
products.description: Access to funds and account management through automated teller machines (ATMs) and debit cards, supporting cash withdrawals, deposits, and purchases. Delivered via physical ATM infrastructure and card networks.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Barnwell develops, produces, and sells crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids, primarily from operated and non-operated wells in Alberta, Canada. Production involves physical extraction, drilling, and ongoing field operations, with sales under short-term commodity contracts to energy marketing companies.

products.name: Land Investment and Real Estate Participation Rights
products.description: Barnwell owns land interests and receives payments based on the sale of residential lots and units in Hawaii, primarily through partnership interests in land development projects. Revenue is generated from contractual rights to a share of proceeds from third-party real estate sales, not from direct development or construction.

products.name: Foodservice Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a full line of food products—including fresh and frozen meats, seafood, produce, dairy, canned and dry goods, bakery, poultry, and beverages—to restaurants, healthcare, education, lodging, and other foodservice customers. Products are sourced from suppliers, stored in multi-temperature warehouses, and delivered via Sysco's logistics network.

products.name: Specialty Food Distribution
products.description: Distribution of specialty food products such as custom-cut meats, seafood, Italian specialties, imported foods, and fresh produce, often through dedicated business units. These products require specialized sourcing, handling, and delivery processes.

products.name: Non-Food Foodservice Supplies Distribution
products.description: Distribution of non-food items including paper products, tableware, cookware, restaurant and kitchen equipment, cleaning supplies, and janitorial products to foodservice and hospitality customers. These products are sourced, warehoused, and delivered alongside food items.

products.name: Hotel Supply Distribution
products.description: Distribution of hotel supplies, including textiles, amenities, and other non-food products, primarily through the Guest Worldwide business. Products are sourced and delivered to lodging establishments and hospitality customers.

products.name: Customized Distribution for Chain Restaurants
products.description: Customized distribution services for quick-service and chain restaurant customers, providing tailored logistics and product offerings to meet specific chain requirements, primarily through the SYGMA division.

products.name: Ancillary Foodservice Support Services
products.description: Provision of ancillary services to foodservice customers, such as product usage reports, menu-planning advice, food safety training, inventory control assistance, and access to third-party business services. These are delivered through consulting and digital tools.

products.name: Implantable Collamer Lenses (ICLs)
products.description: Foldable, biocompatible phakic intraocular lenses made from proprietary Collamer material, designed and manufactured by STAAR for minimally invasive implantation in the eye to correct refractive vision disorders such as myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism, and presbyopia. Delivered via accessory injector systems, these lenses are sold in multiple models and configurations worldwide for elective refractive surgery.

products.name: Lens Delivery Systems (Injectors and Cartridges)
products.description: Accessory delivery systems, including injectors and cartridges, designed and manufactured by STAAR for the minimally invasive implantation of foldable intraocular lenses during ophthalmic surgery. These systems are sold as standalone or preloaded devices to facilitate lens delivery into the eye.

products.name: Money Remittance Services
products.description: Facilitates the transfer of funds from senders to beneficiaries across borders, primarily from the U.S., Canada, Spain, Italy, and Germany to Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Delivered through a network of over 100,000 agents, company-operated stores, and digital channels (websites and mobile apps), leveraging proprietary technology and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Money Transfer Services
products.description: Provides online and mobile app-based money transfer options, allowing consumers to send funds digitally 24/7 from computers or mobile devices. Includes co-branded websites with digital partners and supports various payout methods such as cash pickup, direct deposit, debit cards, mobile wallets, and home delivery in select markets.

products.name: Remittance-as-a-Service (RaaS)
products.description: Offers a platform service to digital partners, enabling them to process money transfers using Intermex's proprietary software systems, money transmitter licenses, and payer network relationships. Revenue is generated from fees for facilitating these partner-initiated transfers.

products.name: Ancillary Financial Processing Solutions and Payment Services
products.description: Provides additional financial services such as online payment options, pre-paid debit cards, and direct deposit payroll cards. These services are delivered through digital platforms and agent networks, and may have different regulatory and risk profiles compared to core remittance services.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas from unconventional shale formations (Marcellus and Utica Shale) and coalbed methane (CBM) properties, primarily in the Appalachian Basin. This involves physical drilling, well development, and ongoing production operations.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs), Oil, and Condensate Sales
products.description: Production and sale of NGLs, oil, and condensate as byproducts from natural gas extraction, marketed to industrial, commercial, and petrochemical markets. These are physically produced and delivered through processing and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Midstream Gas Gathering and Processing Services
products.description: Provision of natural gas gathering, compression, and processing services, including ownership and operation of pipelines and processing facilities. Services are provided both for CNX's own production and for third-party producers, involving regulated infrastructure and physical assets.

products.name: Water Management Services
products.description: Turn-key solutions for water sourcing, delivery, and disposal for natural gas operations, offered both internally and to third parties. This involves physical infrastructure and logistics for water management in drilling and production.

products.name: Environmental Attribute Credits and Carbon Offsets
products.description: Generation and sale of environmental attributes such as carbon credits, methane capture credits, and renewable energy credits, primarily from remediated mine gas (RMG) capture and other emission reduction activities. These are sold to compliance and voluntary markets.

products.name: Enzyme Replacement Therapies for Lysosomal Storage Diseases
products.description: Next-generation enzyme replacement therapies enabled by the proprietary TransportVehicle (TV) platform, designed to deliver enzymes across the blood-brain barrier and throughout the body to treat both central nervous system and somatic manifestations of lysosomal storage diseases. These are biologic drugs manufactured using standard antibody production processes and administered systemically.

products.name: Biotherapeutics for Neurodegenerative Diseases
products.description: Biologic therapeutics, including antibodies and oligonucleotides, enabled by the TV platform to cross the blood-brain barrier for the treatment of common neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. These products are developed using advanced biologic manufacturing and are delivered systemically.

products.name: Small Molecule LRRK2 Inhibitors for Parkinson's Disease
products.description: Orally administered small molecule drugs that inhibit LRRK2 kinase activity, developed to slow the progression of Parkinson's disease. These are chemically synthesized and optimized for blood-brain barrier penetration, and are co-developed and co-commercialized with partners.

products.name: RIPK1 Inhibitors for Peripheral Inflammatory Diseases
products.description: Small molecule inhibitors of RIPK1, developed for the treatment of peripheral inflammatory diseases such as ulcerative colitis. These are chemically synthesized drugs, developed and commercialized in partnership with Sanofi.

products.name: Oncology Biotherapeutics Enabled by TV Platform
products.description: Biologic therapeutics, including mono- and bispecific antibodies (e.g., ATV:HER2), engineered with the TV platform to enhance delivery to both peripheral tumors and brain metastases in HER2-positive cancers. These are manufactured using biologic processes and delivered systemically.

products.name: Gas Delivery Subsystems
products.description: Engineered and manufactured subsystems that deliver, monitor, and control precise quantities of specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. These systems are physically manufactured, integrate multiple components, and are delivered to OEMs for integration into process tools.

products.name: Chemical Delivery Subsystems and Process Modules
products.description: Manufactured subsystems and modules that blend and dispense reactive liquid chemistries and colloidal slurries for semiconductor manufacturing, including modules that apply chemicals directly to wafers. These are physically produced and delivered to OEMs for use in wet process tools.

products.name: Weldments and Specialty Joining Assemblies
products.description: Custom welded assemblies and specialty joining solutions (including orbital, TIG, e-beam, and laser welding, as well as hydrogen and vacuum brazing) for fluid delivery in semiconductor, aerospace, defense, and industrial applications. These are physically manufactured and supplied as components or subsystems.

products.name: Valves
products.description: Manufactured diaphragm valves (conventional, modular, metering, and check valves) engineered for high purity and reliability, used in fluid delivery systems for semiconductor and related industries. These are physical products supplied to OEMs and other customers.

products.name: Advanced Flow Controllers (AFC)
products.description: Patented, state-of-the-art mass flow controllers designed to replace traditional MFCs in fluid delivery subsystems, offering improved performance and compactness for high-precision gas control in semiconductor manufacturing. These are manufactured products supplied to OEMs.

products.name: Precision Machined Components
products.description: Custom precision-machined metal components for semiconductor, aerospace, and defense customers, produced to tight tolerances and complex specifications. These are manufactured parts supplied for integration into customer equipment or subsystems.

products.name: AUCATZYL (obe-cel) CD19 CAR T Cell Therapy
products.description: AUCATZYL is an autologous, genetically engineered T cell therapy targeting CD19, manufactured using proprietary viral vector and semi-automated cell manufacturing processes. It is produced at a dedicated commercial facility and delivered to authorized treatment centers for infusion into patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (r/r B-ALL).

products.name: Obe-cel CD19 CAR T Cell Therapy for Additional Oncology Indications
products.description: Obe-cel, the same CD19 CAR T cell therapy as AUCATZYL, is being developed and delivered for pediatric B-ALL, B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (B-NHL), and other B-cell malignancies. It is manufactured using the same autologous, viral vector-based process and administered at specialized centers.

products.name: Obe-cel CD19 CAR T Cell Therapy for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Obe-cel is being developed as an autologous CD19 CAR T cell therapy for autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), lupus nephritis (LN), and progressive multiple sclerosis (MS), using the same manufacturing and delivery platform as in oncology indications.

products.name: AUTO1/22 Dual-Targeting CAR T Cell Therapy
products.description: AUTO1/22 is an autologous T cell therapy engineered to express both CD19 and CD22 CARs, designed to reduce antigen-negative relapse in B-cell malignancies, especially pediatric ALL. It is manufactured using proprietary viral vector and cell processing technologies and delivered to patients at specialized centers.

products.name: AUTO8 Dual-Targeting CAR T Cell Therapy for Multiple Myeloma and AL Amyloidosis
products.description: AUTO8 is an autologous T cell therapy engineered to express CARs targeting both BCMA and CD19, designed for the treatment of multiple myeloma and light chain (AL) amyloidosis. It is manufactured using proprietary processes and delivered to patients in clinical trials.

products.name: AUTO6/AUTO6NG GD2-Targeted CAR T Cell Therapy for Solid Tumors
products.description: AUTO6 and its next-generation version AUTO6NG are autologous T cell therapies targeting GD2, developed for the treatment of neuroblastoma and other GD2-expressing solid tumors. AUTO6NG incorporates additional programming modules to enhance persistence and resistance to tumor microenvironment suppression. These therapies are manufactured using proprietary processes and delivered to patients in clinical trials.

products.name: General Dentistry Services
products.description: Comprehensive general dental care including preventive, diagnostic, and restorative procedures, delivered in-person by licensed dentists and clinical teams at physical practice locations.

products.name: Specialty Dental Services
products.description: A range of specialty dental treatments including oral surgery, periodontics, pediatric dentistry, prosthodontics, endodontics, and orthodontics, provided by specialists at dedicated practice locations.

products.name: Dental Practice Business Support Services
products.description: Non-clinical business and administrative support for affiliated dental practices, including staffing, facilities, equipment, billing, marketing, IT, and supply chain management, delivered through centralized infrastructure and long-term agreements.
